data.name: PortoBay Teatro
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious 4-Star Stay in the Heart of Porto

Prime Location: Situated in the theatre district of Porto, the PortoBay Hotel Teatro is a stone's throw away from the city's main attractions, making it the perfect base for exploring the historical center.

Chic Design: Following a full refurbishment in 2021, the hotel boasts a fresh and rejuvenated look with Nordic-inspired decor, natural fabrics, and light wood accents creating a cozy ambiance.

Gourmet Dining: Indulge in Italian comfort food at Il Basilico restaurant, offering a delectable selection of bruschettas, tortelloni, pizzas, and risottos. The adjacent bar ensures you can savor these delights even when the restaurant is closed.

Experience luxury and convenience at PortoBay Hotel Teatro - book your stay now!
data.hotelImportantInformation:
Please note that all guests, adults and children, staying at the property must show a valid identity card or passport with photo, or equivalent document (e.g. birth certificate). Minors not accompanied by their parents must have a declaration or authorization to stay, issued by the holder of rights of custody.

Please note that the credit card used to make the payment of the reservation must be from one of the guests staying in the room. If this is not the case, please contact the hotel prior to the check-in date.

Guests are required to show a photo ID and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.
A deposit may be required at the property.

cons: Temperature control issues (cold rooms, central heating/AC airflow)
Slow midday restaurant service on occasion
Shower/ bathroom showing wear (peeling paint) and towel issues
Inability to change bed configuration in at least one case
pros: Excellent central location (near São Bento and main attractions)
Convenient for local food spots and transport

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Rooms and housekeeping are often described as clean and well maintained, but there are isolated issues (towel with holes, peeling paint in shower) that lower the score slightly.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Staff repeatedly praised as friendly, helpful and responsive (stored baggage, birthday cake, attentive reception); overall service is a strong point.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Multiple reviews call the location perfect/ideal — central, minutes from São Bento and main attractions — consistently highlighted as a major advantage.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Beds and comfort receive praise, but several guests report issues: cold rooms due to central heating, poor room layout, inability to convert bed configuration and some bare/decor shortcomings.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Facilities and on-site amenities (breakfast service, bar, general facilities) are positively noted, though there are complaints about AC/central heating airflow, limited late-night bar seating and occasional noise.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Overall value is good given location and service, but at least one reviewer explicitly notes room for improvement for the price paid.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast is frequently described as exceptional and high quality; however restaurant food is described as average by some and the bar/restaurant music can be intrusive at times.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Majority of stays described as excellent or highly enjoyable ('loved our stay', 'excellent séjour'); isolated issues exist but do not outweigh the strong positives.
